Corrections were to display Last Year receipts and to display groups.   No data was changed.
Compared to last Tuesday feeder steers sold mostly steady. Feeder heifers sold 
4.00
 to 
8.00
 higher. There was good demand for feeder and 
yearling classes. Slaughter cows sold 
1.00
 to 
3.00
 lower. No test on slaughter bulls due to no comparable receipts from last weeks sale. 
Moderate demand for slaughter classes.

Please Note:
The above USDA LPGMN price report is reflective of the majority of classes and grades of livestock offered for sale.  
There may be instances where some sales do not fit within reporting guidelines and therefore will not be included in 
the report.  Prices are reported on an FOB basis, unless otherwise noted.
